niche: Central Asian History, Silk Road, Great Rulers (Amir Temur, Babur, Tomyris, Jalal al-Din), Scholars (Al-Khwarizmi, Ibn Sina, Ulugh Beg, Al-Biruni), Culture, Traditions & Tourism

visual_style_dna.mandatory_prompt_prefix: Warm golden-amber and sepia-toned historical graphic novel illustration, bold hand-drawn black ink line art with rich warm watercolor and ochre shading, glowing golden dust particles and sunbeams, cinematic medieval Central Asian / Silk Road atmosphere, intricate historical clothing and turquoise-domed architecture, dramatic storytelling composition, NO text or letters inside the artwork --
visual_style_dna.mandatory_prompt_suffix: , 2D historical comic book art style, warm golden color palette, high contrast ink outlines, masterpiece illustration
visual_style_dna.negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, modern clothes, neon colors, cyberpunk, blurry, deformed hands, watermark, signature, embedded text

youtuber_persona_rules: HOOK (0-3s): Open with a shocking historical paradox, mystery, or visual metaphor that stops the scroll immediately.

VISUAL METAPHOR IN SCENE 1-2: Translate abstract facts into unforgettable visual symbols (e.g., glowing golden animal spirits rising from an ancient book, or a giant cosmic astrolabe glowing above Samarkand).
FAST PACING (2.5-3.5s per frame): Every single sentence gets its own brand-new AI-illustrated scene drawn from scratch.
EMOTIONAL STORYTELLING: Speak like a charismatic, world-class English history YouTuber — never sound like a dry textbook.
LOOPABLE ENDING: End Shorts with a punchy revelation that naturally loops back to the opening question.
